classes.purpose: Client message-color table entry. Maps a message color-id to an actual RGBA/color value, and is used together with CMessageParmDescInfo to colorize localized chat/system messages and substitute {name} placeholders.

methods.purpose: Info-manager accessor. When param_3==0 returns the cached CInfoManager singleton (StcMbrNameSvr registry); otherwise forwards to the generic registry lookup FUN_11679e10 and falls back to a default record (&DAT_1239dc0c).
Returns the raw singleton pointer (*DAT_1239d9e0) if param==0, else 0. Lightweight variant of the manager accessor.

Given a message object (layout A: color-id list at this+0x3c..0x40, output color vector at this+0x4c..0x50, template string at this+0x20): for each color id looks up the CMessageColorInfo record and appends the resolved color value; then tokenizes the template on '{' (0x7b) / '}' (0x7d), and for each {name} placeholder matches it against CMessageParmDescInfo entries (compares desc name at entry+0x14).
Identical logic to 118e1560 but for a second message layout (color-id list at this+0x28..0x2c, output vector at this+0x38..0x3c, template string at this+0x14).

fields.name: colorValue
fields.note: value pulled from the manager's 2-level id table and appended to the message's resolved-color vector

formulas: placeholder scan: FUN_118dfd80(buf, pos, '{', '}', outName) walks {name} tokens; each token name compared to CMessageParmDescInfo entry name at entry+0x14
classes.notes: All four methods share the auto-id 'GetManagers'; only the first two are true manager accessors. The two big methods are the message color/parameter resolver in two struct layouts. No matching TLV doc (this is a client-only display table).

classes.purpose: Equipment enchant / attribute-bonus table entry. Drives building of an equipment's full enchant detail block (per-slot enchant attributes, names, descriptions) for tooltip display / network report.

methods.purpose: Singleton accessor: registers the class name with the shared-memory CInfoManager registry (StcMbrNameSvr) on first call and returns DAT_123be4f8.

Large builder (~0x226d8-byte work buffer) that assembles a full equipment detail record from an equip item (param_3): calls dozens of item-attribute getters (FUN_1134xxxx), copies the item name (FUN_100ebf60, 0x100), parses a comma-separated numeric list (up to 20 ints via FUN_100e4b30 + atoi), then walks up to 24 enchant/attribute slots reading each attribute's type/value/name(0x20)/description(0x40) via its vtable, resolving enchant records through the CEquipEnchantInfo manager, and finally hands the assembled struct to a network/UI sink (vtable+0x568).

fields.name: maxAttrSlots
fields.note: loop bound 0x18 (24) attribute slots, each stride 0xe4 bytes in the work buffer

fields.name: csvValueList
fields.note: comma-separated (0x2c) list parsed with atoi, capped at 20 entries

formulas: per-slot buffer stride = slot * 0xe4 bytes; description strings copied at 0x40, names at 0x20
classes.notes: Only the first method is the true singleton accessor. The second is a tooltip/detail assembler, not a TLV parser. Heavy stack usage confirms it builds a large transient display struct. Field offsets inside the equip item are opaque here (item passed as param_3).

nameNext.why: family of FUN_1134xxxx item-attribute getters feeding the detail struct
resolves an attribute record used per slot

classes.purpose: Shop commodity-library entry. Each record has a commodity type field (1/2/3) and is grouped into commodity groups (CCommodityGroupInfo) and linked to NPC sale lists (CNpcSaleInfo). Provides type-filtered lookups and init/cleanup passes over all commodities.

methods.purpose: Singleton accessor for the commodity-lib CInfoManager (returns DAT_123be128).

Resolves references held by an object: iterates up to 20 commodity-lib ids (param_2, stride 0x212, id at +1) through the CCommodityLibInfo manager, then up to 128 group ids (param_2+0x1568, stride 0xe, short id at -6) through the CCommodityGroupInfo manager; finalizes with FUN_114b87c0.
Walks every CCommodityLibInfo record and appends those whose type field (record+0x20)==2 into the caller-supplied 3-pointer vector (param_1).
Returns the first CCommodityLibInfo record with type field (record+0x20)==1, else 0.
Like CollectByType2 but collects records whose type (record+0x20)==3 into the output vector.

For each commodity-lib record, gets its id (vtable+0x18), resolves the matching CNpcSaleInfo record, then iterates the sale's entry list (piVar2[5]..[6]) calling FUN_117da950 twice per entry to release/unregister NPC-sale references.
Iterates all commodity-lib records, invoking FUN_11721190 on each (per-record init/precache step).
Iterates all commodity-lib records calling CNpcSaleInfo::GetManagers_11720f30 per record, then runs ClearNpcSaleRefs (11722190). Top-level commodity/NPC-sale initialization pass.

fields.note: used to bucket/filter records; 1,2,3 seen

classes.purpose: Sculpture (carving) activity definition entry. Records are keyed/grouped by a library id (record+0x28 / record+0x14) and used to build per-player sculpture maps and to collect sculptures belonging to a given library.

methods.purpose: Singleton accessor for the sculpture CInfoManager (returns DAT_123c8698).

Computes a key (param_1 vtable+0xc4 -> +0x14), scans all sculpture records for the first whose record[10] (offset 0x28)==key, and appends the {param_1, record} pair to the global vector DAT_1202e12c; returns 1 on match.

Iterates up to 10 sculpture ids from param_2, resolves each record, does a red-black-tree lookup/insert keyed by id in this+0x38, and for matches inserts a computed entry (FUN_11181ba0(record) value + FUN_114b15a0()) via FUN_11181320; finalizes via vtable at this+0xc.

Parses/expands id lists (FUN_1013ec30) resolving sculpture records (FUN_114b2470) then runs a nested pass (outer count at param_2+0x105 max 4, inner max 10 stride 0x185) building map entries and driving the owner object's vtable at this+0xc (+0x18/+0x10).
Scans all records for the first whose record[10] (0x28)==param_1 and returns that record's id (vtable+0x18 result), else 0.
Iterates all sculpture records calling FUN_11a54280 on each (per-record processing pass).
Iterates all sculpture records calling CSculptureLibInfo::GetManagers_11a540b0 per record (library init/link pass).
For each record, compares record[5] (offset 0x14) against (param_1 vtable+0x18 result); appends matching records to the vector at param_1[0xf]/param_1[0x10].

classes.purpose: Sub-group table for equipment random passive skills. Each sub-group holds a list of (skill, weight) entries; used to pick the best sub-group for a skill and to randomly roll passive-skill sets together with CEquipRandPassiveSkillActivateGroupInfo.

methods.purpose: Info-manager accessor / GetById wrapper (returns singleton at DAT_122e0474 or default record).

Given a skill id (param_1), a flag (param_2), and a list of sub-group ids (param_3): iterates sub-groups, scans each sub-group's entry list (record+0x18..0x1c); if an entry's skill (entry[0])==param_1, either returns the first match (param_2<0) or tracks the sub-group whose entry weight (entry[8]) is highest and returns it.
Returns raw singleton pointer when param==0.

RNG-driven passive-skill roll: computes a random draw count using rand (FUN_100ee450) * _DAT_11de9a60 over a [min..max] range (min 3), rolls candidate entries (FUN_11867d00/f60/f50), resolves each sub-group and its activate-group (CEquipRandPassiveSkillActivateGroupInfo), and emits generated skill results via FUN_1163c850.

Second roll variant (uses FUN_11868050 to fetch candidates and FUN_11638b60 to validate activate group; same random-count math and FUN_1163c850 emission), operating on sub-group id list at this+0x2c..0x30.

Dispatches on a mode field at this+0x3c: mode 1 walks the flat id list at this+0x2c..0x30; mode 2 walks nested per-node lists (node+0xc..0x10); each iteration forces the sub-group manager to load (preload/validate references).

fields.name: entryList
fields.note: sub-group's (skill,weight) entries

fields.name: entrySkillId
fields.note: matched against requested skill id

fields.name: entryWeight
fields.note: weight/level; max selects the sub-group

fields.name: mode
fields.note: list layout selector in TouchSubGroupRefs

formulas: rollCount = base - floor(rand01 * _DAT_11de9a60 * (range+1)), clamped to >=1 and >=3 candidates then processed
classes.notes: The two roll methods are the core random-passive-skill generator; SelectSubGroupForSkill is a weighted best-match. Exact rng constant _DAT_11de9a60 is a double (likely 1/RAND_MAX). Activate-group class CEquipRandPassiveSkillActivateGroupInfo is a sibling table.

nameNext.why: computes per-entry value used in the emitted result

classes.purpose: Soul-stone attribute table entry. Each record carries an attribute-id list and a value/type; methods sum attribute values (optionally by type), apply attribute totals to a character, and collect attributes for a given entity.

methods.purpose: Singleton accessor for the soul-stone-attr CInfoManager (returns DAT_123be57c).

Walks a red-black tree at this+0x34 (nodes keyed by id at node+0x10); for each resolves the CSoulStoneAttrInfo record, iterates its attr-id list (record+0x50..0x54), calls a game-attribute resolver (vtable of this+8 obj, +0x44, args 0,attrId,0,1,0x29) and appends positive results to the vector at this+0x68..0x6c.
Walks the rb-tree, resolves each soul-stone-attr record and sums record+0x18 (value) across all; returns the total.
Same as SumAttrValue but only sums record+0x18 for records whose type (record+0x30)==param_2.

For each attr record (rb-tree walk) builds a '{0}:{1}' id:name debug string, iterates the record's sub-attributes (count record[6]=0x18, array record[5]=0x14 via FUN_115342b0) summing +0x38 and +0x48 into two accumulators, then applies the totals to the owning character: char[10] (+0x28) += sum1 (clamped to 0x7fffffff), and vtable+0x278(sum2,0x27,0) for the second stat; rebuilds/refreshes afterward.

Iterates all soul-stone-attr records; where record[0xc] (offset 0x30)==entity id (local_10 vtable+0x18 result) appends the record to two vectors (entity[0x11]/[0x12] and a keyed list from FUN_11a7b9c0 keyed by record[5]).

classes.purpose: Projectile / fly-object definition entry. Holds model, AI (behavior tree/skill), hit-part, and preload reference lists. The main method preloads all resources referenced by a projectile data node (models, effects, sub fly-objects, monsters).

methods.purpose: Info-manager accessor / GetById wrapper (singleton at DAT_1202f608, default record fallback &DAT_1202f638).
Returns the raw singleton pointer when param==0.

Given a data-node name and a preload flag, reads projectile config keys and preloads their resources: 'sfileModel' (CGF model), 'AISetting' -> 'sSkill' + 'sBlackBoardFile' (behavior tree under 'Scripts/AI/BehaviorTree/') + 'sequip_EquipmentPack', 'HitPartSetting' -> 'sHitPartInfo', 'sPreloadFlyObjInfo' (list of projectile ids: preloads each record's models at +0x134/+0x168 and effect at +0x1c4), 'spreloadeffects', and 'sPreloadMonsterInfo' (list of monster names resolved through CMonsterInfo, preloaded). Records loaded model handles into this+0x4c and preloaded-name/monster lists into this+0x54/0x58.

Iterates the preloaded projectile-id list at this+0x58 and releases each referenced record's resources: model at +0x134 and +0x168 (release via manager vtable+0x9c) and effect at +0x1c4 (FUN_110038f0).

classes.purpose: Dragon Box lottery prize-pool entry. Each prize record has an item id + count and a pool/type key; methods grant pending prizes to a player and build the per-player prize/gift/shop pools (joining CDragonBoxBlackFaceGiftInfo and CDragonBoxShop).

methods.purpose: Singleton accessor for the dragon-box-prize CInfoManager (returns DAT_123c837c).

Iterates the player's pending-prize list (this[0x13]..[0x14]); for each entry in state 1 marks it state 2, resolves the prize record, and grants it: FUN_109cf680(0x50,4) then FUN_1149ad80(record+0x24 itemId, record+0x28 count, 2), pushing the reward through the player object (vtable at *param_1+0x2d1c, +0x50).

Builds the full dragon-box pools for a context object: (1) all CDragonBoxPrizeInfo records with record+0x18==ctx+0x10 are bucketed by state/type record+0x14 into ctx vectors at +0x5c/+0x44/+0x50; (2) all CDragonBoxBlackFaceGiftInfo records bucketed by record[5] matching ctx+0x6c/0x70/0x74; (3) all CDragonBoxShop records bucketed by record+0x34 matching ctx+0x78/0x80; then commits each bucket (FUN_118166c0/FUN_11816750 + FUN_1155b7a0/FUN_1155b880) and frees the temporaries.
Iterates all dragon-box-prize records calling FUN_11a06de0 on each (per-record processing pass).
Iterates all dragon-box-prize records calling CDragonBoxInfo::GetManagers_11a06c20 per record (dragon-box init/link pass).
